parameters.name: AddressId
parameters.description: The mailing address ID. This ID corresponds to the `ID` parameter returned by the `QueryCustomerAddressList` operation.

parameters.name: ApplyUserNick
parameters.description: The applicant nickname. The system does not verify this value.

parameters.name: CustomerId
parameters.description: The invoicing customer ID. This ID corresponds to the `ID` parameter returned by the `QueryInvoicingCustomerList` operation.

parameters.name: InvoiceByAmount
parameters.description: Specifies whether to create an invoice for a specific amount. If you set this parameter to `true`, an invoice is created for the amount specified in the `InvoiceAmount` parameter. If you set this parameter to `false`, an invoice is created for the total amount of the items specified in the `SelectedIds` parameter.

parameters.name: InvoicingType
parameters.description:
The invoice type. Valid values:

- 0: special invoice

- 1: general invoice

parameters.name: ProcessWay
parameters.description:
The invoicing channel. This parameter must be set to 1. The following list describes the channel types:

- 0: Processed by Alibaba Cloud (Not applicable to this operation)

- 1: Processed by the tax platform

parameters.name: SelectedIds
parameters.description: The IDs of the items to be invoiced. These IDs correspond to the `ID` parameter returned by the `QueryEvaluateList` operation.

parameters.name: emails
parameters.description: The email addresses of the invoice recipient. To specify multiple addresses, separate them with commas (,). The value cannot exceed 200 characters.
